title: Fixed-orbit affine torsor descent step
statement: Under the finite faithfully flat affine torsor hypotheses and a splitting of the finite etale cover into d components on T, there exist m <= d and the actual orbit stabilizers K(k) such that the corresponding fixed-ring product principal-open scheme is isomorphic over Spec H to the base-changed cover. The orbit data are chosen existentially from the descent action, never supplied arbitrarily.

proof.text: Apply affine_torsor_equivariant_descent to obtain the actual action alpha on Fin d and an isomorphism over Spec H to the principal open in the algebra of equivariant functions.

Apply the completely proved affine_torsor_equivariant_orbit_product to obtain m<=d, actual stabilizers K, and an H-algebra equivalence with their fixed-ring product. Apply Spec to the inverse ring equivalence, restrict it using SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen and Scheme.Hom.preimageIso, and compose with the descent isomorphism. The algebra equivalence commutes with algebraMap, and Over.w gives the required projection compatibility.

proof_origin.note: Corrects the arbitrary-orbit interface. Complete Lean composition; the algebraic orbit decomposition is proved and only geometric descent remains open.

statement_change.old_statement: Under the finite faithfully flat affine torsor hypotheses, after choosing finitely many orbit representatives and stabilizers bounded by the number of split components, the corresponding fixed-ring principal-open scheme is isomorphic to the base change.
statement_change.what: Arbitrary m and K are invalid: m=0 with the degree-one identity cover over Q yields empty fixed-ring spectrum for a nonempty base change. Choose m,K from the actual descent action existentially and retain the source bound m<=d. Preserve the checked counterexample to the former interface.
